tooltip.robotica.stumpy.details:
Place it among trees, with a chest or Supply Crate touching it.
Right-click it with a wound Mainspring or a cell to power it.
Right-click with an upgrade card to install the card.
Sneak-right-click: status and work area. It keeps saplings to replant.
tooltip.robotica.sprout.details:
Place it in a field, with a chest or Supply Crate touching it.
Right-click it with a wound Mainspring or a cell to power it.
It tills dirt next to water and replants from its harvest.
Sneak-right-click: status and work area.
tooltip.robotica.excavator.details:
Place it where the hole should start: it digs everything below it.
Power: a cell in its slot, or FE from a conduit.
A chest touching it gets the drops. Fluids get sealed with cobblestone.
Range cards make the hole 16 to 64 wide. A Void card deletes junk.
tooltip.robotica.supply_crate.details:
Place it touching a robot: the robot fills it.
Hoppers and pipes can empty it from any side.

tooltip.robotica.survey_rig: Mines its chunk's ores without digging a hole
tooltip.robotica.survey_rig.details:
Scans its own chunk once, from its height down to the bottom, into an ore ledger.
Then it pulls one ore at a time out of the ledger: no hole, no lag. Very slow without speed cards.
Each speed card costs more FE per ore than the last. Fortune or Silk Touch cards apply.
A Magma Core in its core slot lets it take ancient debris. A mined-out chunk is surveyed for good.
